associationCaveat: Native OSM Hong Kong districts (admin_level=6), not mainland counties or official administrative certification. Area-query and available explicit admin_centre/subarea evidence do not prove complete polygon containment; every point must pass the original Hong Kong parent fence. Missing division_code uses osm-r relation IDs.
matchBasis: Queried exact OSM CN-HK r913110 native level3 parent and 18 actual level6 districts; original WGS84 geometry retained without repairs or invented administrative codes. Native parent strict validation fails because two inner rings touch; parentUsable=false, parent retained for audit only, all Hong Kong points must remain unmatched.
